name: no-eligible-holders
note: Spec §5: W == 0 is a legitimate state, not an error. The Converter is the only address holding NUTZ and it is Excluded, so a funded Epoch produces no Allocations and no Root at all — engineering spec §3.3's Skipped mechanism rolls the whole base of 5100 per token into Carry. A root of null is the expectation here, and the Verifier reports MATCH for it rather than INDETERMINATE.
